candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout correlation failing at the order call with 500 Internal Server Error, and gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs and internal error detail are excluded, so the specific order failure mode (e.g. db pool, redis) is not established.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are caused by order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, confirmed by correlated traces and gateway metrics. The precise order-side fault is not yet bounded, so only the http-500 candidate is offered.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/errors for POST /v1/orders during the incident window
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to identify the failing sub-dependency
